## Standing operator rules
Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in `requirements/license-tools.txt` rather than using `>=` or a floating latest version.

Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.

Run “Kafka repartition offset migration” between other work, one step at a time, in the specified order.

Sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

## Current objective
Finish typing `ledgerly/billing/invoices.py` and related billing entry points. Vendor-credit CSV import is paused/superseded for now.

## Ruled-out approaches
Retrying every `HTTPStatusError` is ruled out because 4xx responses must fail immediately.

Pinning `httpx` to 0.23 is ruled out because it broke the Stripe client.

## Plan and progress
Kafka steps 1–5 done; 6–9 pending, next command unknown.

Invoice tests: done (12 passed). Annotated invoice helpers and `post_entry`; `compileall` and tests pass. `mypy ledgerly/billing/invoices.py` found one `Returning Any` error. Next: inspect line 74 and add a safe type-narrowing/cast, then rerun mypy.

## Recent work
CSV UTF-8 fix passed Ruff, whitespace checks, and full tests (186 passed, 3 skipped). Invoice annotations preserve behavior; `reverse_entry` and `account_balance` remain untyped.
